workflow: Read the code carefully and understand the intent
Identify functional bugs (off-by-one, null handling, logic errors)
Identify security issues (injection, traversal, auth, secrets)
Suggest concrete fixes with code examples

rubric.name: correctness
rubric.description: Did the review identify the functional bugs in the code (off-by-one, null handling, edge cases)? 0 = missed all bugs; 10 = caught every bug in the reference answer

rubric.name: security
rubric.description: Did the review identify the security issues (injection, traversal, auth, secrets, race conditions)? 0 = missed all security flaws; 10 = identified every security issue in the reference answer

rubric.name: actionability
rubric.description: Did the review suggest concrete fixes the developer can apply, ideally with code examples? 0 = vague advice only; 10 = clear, specific fixes with example code

rubric.name: conciseness
rubric.description: Was the review well-organized and proportional to the issues found? 0 = rambling or padded; 10 = tight, prioritized, no fluff
